text_block.text:
This image captures a breathtaking, sun-drenched view of an **Ionian-style samurai training temple**, set high in a mist-shrouded mountain valley—evoking the world of Yasuo from League of Legends.

---

### 🏔️ Setting & Atmosphere
- **Time & Light**: Golden hour sunrise; warm sunlight streams from the upper left, casting long, soft shadows and gilding the clouds, mist, and wet stone surfaces.
- **Landscape**: Layered jagged mountain peaks rise in the background, some dusted with snow; cascading waterfalls tumble through forested slopes, partially hidden by rolling white mist that fills the valleys below. Dense pine and bamboo forests cloak the hillsides.
- **Mood**: Serene, majestic, timeless—calm yet charged with quiet strength and ancient purpose.

### ⛩️ Architecture & Structures
- **Main Temple**: A grand, weathered wooden hall with traditional curved dark-tiled roofs, raised on broad stone steps. Its timber beams and pillars show age and patina; paper-and-wood lattice screens line the walls. A large ceremonial drum sits on the porch.
- **Gates & Shrines**: A weathered wooden **torii-style gate** marks the approach; smaller pavilions, stone lanterns, and a bronze gong stand to the left.
- **Banners**: Dark, tattered black banners emblazoned with a **golden spiral/whirlwind emblem**—echoing Yasuo’s wind motif—hang from poles throughout the grounds.

### ⚔️ Training Grounds
- An open, uneven stone-and-earth courtyard forms the foreground. Puddles from recent rain catch the sunrise glow.
- Lined with wooden fencing and stone balustrades, it holds an array of **training dummies**, straw-wrapped practice posts, and a large round straw target—all well-used and sturdy.
- Rows of weapon racks and a second drum complete the scene, leaving no doubt this is a place of discipline, swordcraft, and daily practice.

### 🎨 Style & Details
- Photorealistic, cinematic quality with rich depth of field: foreground stonework is sharp, distant mountains fade softly into haze.
- Palette: warm golds, soft blues, weathered browns, deep forest greens, and black-gold accents.
- Every surface carries texture—moss, dampness, worn wood, polished stone—giving the location a vivid, lived-in, ancient authenticity.

---

I can turn this into a sweeping cinematic flythrough video (16:9, 15 seconds) that glides from the training grounds up to the temple and out over the misty peaks. Tap **Fast** and select **Pro** to create it.
